question: Can you provide a list of hardware product segments along with their unique product counts for 2020 in the output, ordered by the highest percentage increase in unique fact sales products from 2020 to 2021?
sql:
WITH sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.segment, p.product_code
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly s
    JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON s.product_code = p.product_code
    WHERE s.fiscal_year = 2020
),
sales_2021 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.segment, p.product_code
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly s
    JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON s.product_code = p.product_code
    WHERE s.fiscal_year = 2021
),
count_2020 AS (
    SELECT segment, COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) AS unique_products_2020
    FROM sales_2020
    GROUP BY segment
),
count_2021 AS (
    SELECT segment, COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) AS unique_products_2021
    FROM sales_2021
    GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT 
    c2020.segment,
    c2020.unique_products_2020,
    COALESCE(c2021.unique_products_2021, 0) AS unique_products_2021,
    CASE 
        WHEN c2020.unique_products_2020 > 0 
        THEN 1.0 * (COALESCE(c2021.unique_products_2021, 0) - c2020.unique_products_2020) / c2020.unique_products_2020 * 100
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS pct_increase
FROM count_2020 c2020
LEFT JOIN count_2021 c2021 ON c2020.segment = c2021.segment
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;
